cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(ponca-tutorial)

####################################################################################################
## Do not edit this file, but rather configure cmake according to your need
## USER OPTIONS
##
option(PONCA_TUTORIALS_VERBOSE "Enable verbose output in tutorials" ON)

if (DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    SET(CPM_SOURCE_CACHE $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE} CACHE PATH "CPM Source cache")
else()
    SET(CPM_SOURCE_CACHE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cache CACHE PATH "CPM Source cache")
endif()

add_subdirectory(tutorials)
##
## END USER OPTIONS
####################################################################################################
